SELECT TOP(1) [s].[Value]
FROM (

                    SELECT CAST(SUM(p.rows) AS BIGINT) AS Value
                    FROM sys.partitions AS p
                    INNER JOIN sys.tables AS t ON p.object_id = t.object_id
                    WHERE t.name = 'Historial_Precios' AND p.index_id IN (0, 1);
) AS [s]

) AS [s]
